visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a light grey oversized hoodie is kneeling on a vibrant purple carpeted floor in an indoor hallway. Their hood is pulled completely forward, covering their entire head and face, and is being held by a hand reaching from above the frame. The individual is holding a black and white recorder with both hands, positioned as if playing the instrument. The background consists of a plain off-white wall and a brown wooden door. (2) The person continues to kneel and hold the recorder, while their fingers move over the holes to play a melody. Above them, various digital overlays appear, including a musical staff with notes, a line of phonetic-style symbols, a sequence of musical note letters, and a series of numbers. A large, bold white text overlay reading 'NOT CUTE ANYMORE' is centered over their body. (3) The hand holding the hood suddenly pulls it back, revealing the face of a young woman with dark hair. She looks toward the camera with a cheerful, smiling expression while continuing to blow into the mouthpiece of the recorder. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout the scene, suggesting a well-lit indoor residential environment.
